text:
The plan is written and committed, and I've built nothing. Each part is smaller than you expected because most of it already exists. I'm waiting for your go on the shape.

### What's already there
- **`Page.class.js` is 745 lines, not thousands.** It was split on 2026-10-12, down from 2,270 lines. The problem now is that it's too wide: about 100 methods, and 49 of them are one-line forwarders that build a throwaway helper object on every call.
- **Content by type already works** for headings, markdown text of any length, cards and links. The one missing type is a custom view class as a content item.
- **Readmes are already browsable.** Add `md/` to any page's url and you get that folder's markdown files, rendered ([try it](/framework/core/Item/md/)). Two things are missing: a folder with only a `readme.md` doesn't open as a page yet, and a page can't put a markdown file among its own content parts.

### What I'd build, in this order (each in a worktree, each merge yours)
1. **(a) Two new content types.** `part-view` puts a custom view class into a page's content. `part-file` puts a markdown file there. The item tool will list the known types and refuse unknown ones; today an unknown type is quietly saved and shows up as bare text.
2. **(b) A folder with only a `readme.md` opens as a page.** The readme comes first; a `page.js` added later takes over.
3. **(c) Page goes down to about 250 lines, in three scripted steps.** The last step changes a dozen or more callers, so its merge is the one that waits for your OK.

### Where it is
- The plan, with the example lines and my default choices plus their alternatives: [plan.md](/framework/core/Page/tasks/page-mastermind/plan.md)
- The ready and plan cards are on [my session page](/framework/ai/sessions/83e9996a-176b-4ef5-83e8-642545b3ddd9/).
- a, b and c are filed as three subtasks on the [task](/framework/core/Page/tasks/page-mastermind/), so the old 10-09 task shows as running again.

I'm idle. I've finished the plan and posted it as [plan.md](/framework/core/Page/tasks/page-mastermind/plan.md), and I'm waiting for the owner to approve its shape before building anything, as the brief says. Nothing is running, so I haven't set a wake-up.
